verdict.rationale: three.js publishes an API reference at threejs.org/docs (hash-routed pages for classes such as GLTFLoader and OrbitControls), a separate examples gallery (e.g. webgl_animation_keyframes) that a community user calls good, and a browser-based editor. However, the evidence never shows the reference itself being interactive or embedding runnable code next to API entries; the examples are a separate gallery, and the page-level linking between the two is only implied by titles. Missing for 10: evidence that API reference pages embed or link runnable or editable examples, a description of the examples' interactivity, and independent hands-on corroboration of the docs-plus-examples experience.
